cues: Newton Raphson, from the cold open: x n plus one is x n minus f over f dash.
Near a root, the error is squared at every step.
Watch the error column: about a tenth, then five thousandths, then two hundred thousandths, then two ten-billionths.
The number of correct digits roughly doubles each time.
